thought: This scene establishes the guerrilla warfare atmosphere at Wolf Fang Mountain's base. Since it focuses on silhouettes moving through terrain rather than detailed character features, and no character references are specified, I'll create 2 keyframes: (1) Opening frame using Ref type to establish the mountainous terrain with setting_201 reference and initial soldier positions, (2) Mid/end frame using Modify type to show movement progression. The emphasis is on dramatic lighting creating strong silhouettes, the rugged rocky terrain, and the sense of stealthy, agile movement characteristic of guerrilla tactics.

keyframe_prompt.sketch_prompt: Medium wide shot, simple line art sketch. Composition layout: Base of mountain occupying background and mid-ground, foreground with large rocky outcroppings and sparse trees creating natural frames. Four to five soldier silhouettes positioned at left and center-left of frame on rugged mountain path, in various crouching and moving poses suggesting stealthy advance. Rocks and vegetation creating shadows and cover. Mountain path winds from lower left toward center-right. Rule of thirds: soldiers occupy left third, rocky terrain and path create leading lines toward right. Low angle perspective, slight upward tilt emphasizing mountain looming above. Clear spatial separation between foreground rocks, mid-ground soldiers, background mountain base.
keyframe_prompt.remix_prompt: Medium wide shot at base of Wolf Fang Mountain, autumn 1941. Reference setting_201 for environmental details and apply its terrain characteristics to background and mid-ground. Exposure: ISO 400, f/5.6, 1/125s. Lighting: Dramatic chiaroscuro with strong directional backlighting creating pronounced silhouettes, harsh late afternoon light from upper right creating deep shadows in rock crevices and behind terrain features, rim lighting outlining soldier figures and rock edges. Composition: Low-angle perspective looking slightly upward, rule of thirds with soldiers positioned in left third, rocky terrain creating natural leading lines from lower left to center-right, foreground dominated by large craggy rock formations and sparse withered trees framing the scene. Depth of Field: Moderate to deep, f/5.6, foreground rocks slightly softer, soldiers and mid-ground terrain in sharp focus, background mountain base detailed. Lens: 35mm prime lens. Genre: Historical war documentary, environmental narrative. Style: Realistic thick-painted 2D animation aesthetic, strong light-dark contrast, low-saturation earth-tone color palette emphasizing gravity and harshness. Soldiers (left and center-left of frame): Four to five Eighth Route Army fighters rendered primarily as dark silhouettes against lighter background, agile crouching and moving poses suggesting stealth and speed, utilizing rocks and vegetation as cover, figures partially obscured by shadows, minimal facial detail, emphasis on posture and movement suggesting trained guerrilla tactics. Setting Details: Rugged rocky terrain with jagged boulders and stone outcroppings in foreground, winding treacherous mountain path cutting through mid-ground from left to right, sparse dried autumn vegetation and scraggly trees casting long shadows, exposed rock walls and cliff base visible in background. Color Palette: Desaturated earth tones - withered yellow and ochre rocks, grey-brown stone, muted sienna soil, dark umber shadows, soldier silhouettes rendered in deep sepia-black tones, cool grey-blue in shadowed areas. Atmospheric effects: Slight haze or dust in air suggesting wartime conditions, volumetric light rays cutting through gaps in rocks, particulate matter visible in light beams. Texture: Rough craggy rock surfaces with visible stratification, weathered stone, dried grass, coarse tree bark. Mood: Tense, grave, emphasizing stealth and danger, showcasing guerrilla warfare tactics in harsh terrain.

keyframe_prompt.modify_prompt: Modify scene_2_1 to show temporal progression of soldier movement. Soldiers (originally at left and center-left): Reposition silhouettes to have advanced 30-40% further along the mountain path toward center and center-right of frame, maintaining their silhouetted rendering and stealthy crouching poses but in new positions suggesting 2-3 seconds of forward movement. The lead soldier should now be approaching center frame, trailing soldiers spread along the path behind. Maintain all other elements: Keep identical camera angle, lighting direction, and environmental details. Keep the dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with strong backlighting. Keep rock formations, trees, and terrain features in exact same positions. Adjust only the cast shadows from soldiers to match their new positions. Atmosphere and color palette remain unchanged. The modification emphasizes the continuous stealthy movement through the shadowy terrain, creating sense of practiced guerrilla tactics and urgent but controlled advance.
